DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica (Lumbar Radiculopathy).

Based on your report of sudden, sharp lower back pain radiating to your foot after exercise, this clinical picture is classic for a pinched nerve in the lower spine. To confirm the severity, did you experience any loss of bladder or bowel control, or did your leg give way completely?
